sentence: Peaoui fades by morning. Shekira needs no second look.

wombos.definition: A feminine Kirk Aura — the twin or female-coded counterpart to Kira, radiating high-level presence and magnetism.
wombos.example: She walked in with full Shekira and everyone noticed immediately.

wombos.definition: An exclamation of attraction directed at someone who is peak — a catcall or expression of awe at an exceptionally attractive person.
wombos.example: A serendookie walked by and he just said 'Peaoui' under his breath.
